title: When Strippers Go Wild: Drunken Stripper's Reckless Hit & Run & Assault!
description:
On April 30th, 2023, an officer in Ohio spotted a stopped vehicle flagged by a Flock camera involving a blue Buick Enclave flagged for the owner having several felony warrants. The vehicle was involved in a hit-and-run incident before fleeing. The officer initiated a traffic stop at a car dealership parking lot of the driver, a female suspect, who appeared intoxicated. The situation escalated as the suspect resisted cooperation, displaying hostile and erratic behavior towards the officers on the scene.

The suspect admitted to drinking while interacting with the officers while giving conflicting statements. The woman became increasingly non-compliant, refusing to provide her current address and behaving aggressively. The scene turned chaotic as she kicked inside the patrol car, causing damage. Her behavior continued during her transport to the county jail, but a medical clearance was required first due to her earlier involvement in a vehicle accident. She was transported to the hospital, where she was medically cleared.

The female suspect was charged with Operating a Vehicle While Intoxicated (OVI), Obstructing Official Business, Criminal Damaging/Endangering, and Assault.
